title: Retire lore-cli's per-repo quest skill for the opum-quest plugin
description: User decision (via opum-agent OPAG-41): opum-quest@opum 0.3.4 is installed at user scope, so retire lore-cli's per-repo .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md the same way LCLI-443/444 retired the per-repo lore skill for opum-lore. Requires quest CLI 0.3.4 (confirmed installed). Sequenced after the 0.4.4 lore-cli release per the orchestrator's explicit instruction.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest init --reconfigure --skill-source plugin (no actor flags -- init is not a tracker write) writes [agents] skill_source = "plugin" to .quest/workspace.toml
quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 6 naming .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md as drift before removal
quest agents --update-instructions --target claude --force removes the file only if its bytes match what 0.3.4 generates; a stale pre-0.3.4 copy is refused and removed by hand instead
the re-run check exits 0 and no AGENTS.md reappears (Codex bridge stays retired)
CLAUDE.md quest managed block version note moves 0.3.3 -> 0.3.4 outside the fleet block, and the fleet block digest still reads ccb1b28f83cdfeb8

finalSummary: Retired lore-cli's per-repo quest skill for the opum-quest plugin, mirroring LCLI-443/444's lore-skill retirement. quest init --reconfigure --skill-source plugin (no actor flags -- init is not a tracker write) wrote [agents] skill_source = "plugin" to .quest/workspace.toml. quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude then exited 6 (drift, naming the block/skill state as not current). quest agents --update-instructions --target claude --force refreshed CLAUDE.md's quest managed block (0.3.3 -> 0.3.4 in its own prose) but correctly REFUSED to remove .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md -- it was a stale pre-0.3.4 copy that did not byte-match what 0.3.4 generates, exactly as briefed. Removed it by hand with git rm -r. Re-ran the check: exit 0, no AGENTS.md reappeared (Codex bridge stays retired). Fleet block digest verified unaffected: ccb1b28f83cdfeb8, unchanged. Updated docs/reference/lore-cli-repository-notes.md's project-level-skills inventory (zero now, not one) and CLAUDE.md's own pointer sentence ("why zero" instead of "why exactly two"). lore check 77 files/0 errors, full suite 2855 pass/1 skip/0 fail, typecheck clean, lint clean.
